records.quote: On the basis of structural, magnetic and numerical studies of the cubic ZnCr2-xNixSe4 (x = 0.1-0.3), we show that simple ionic model is not suitable for consistent description of the properties of the system.
context_quotes: On the basis of the numerical calculations performed for x = 0.2, we obtain the agreement between the local magnetic moments on Cr (3.18 mu(B)) and Ni (-0.49 mu(B)) ions and the value obtained from neutron powder diffraction 2.65(3) mu(B) as well as saturation magnetization.
modality_evidence: On the basis of the numerical calculations performed for x = 0.2, we obtain the agreement between the local magnetic moments on Cr (3.18 mu(B)) and Ni (-0.49 mu(B)) ions and the value obtained from neutron powder diffraction 2.65(3) mu(B) as well as saturation magnetization.

record.subject: Internal competing interactions in ACr2Se4 selenospinels
record.object: Tunable thermoelectric, magnetoresistive and magnetocapacitance properties
record.quote: Selenospinels ACr(2)Se(4) form a broad class of materials with tunable properties, including thermoelectric, magnetoresistive and magnetocapacitance, related to the internal competing interactions.
